Definition: from G1656; compassionateness, i.e. (as exercised towards the poor) beneficence, or (concretely) a benefaction:--alms(-deeds).
BiblicalUsage: eleēmosýnē is a plain word for alms, charitable giving. In Matthew 6:2, the text says "Therefore when thou doest [thine] alms." In Matthew 6:3, the text says "But when thou doest alms."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe eleēmosýnē shows us that generosity is not giving what is left over; it is giving because God gave first. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
